messages:
alex: Quick sync — CloudBundle marketplace listing + HW SKU pipeline. T-48h to embargo. Need owners for assets, SI validation, price band, and legal quote.

mina: I can take landing copy and images. Will push draft to /staging by 09:00 PT tomorrow.

oscar: SI validation slot available tomorrow 11:00 PT. I27ll run the connector deploy and smoke tests. Need partner eng on call.

ravi: Partner uploaded assets to s3://cloudbundle-assets/marketplace/2210/ but hero is low-res. Asked for hi-res by EOD. OK to use placeholders for preview.

alex: Embargo set for 2026-06-01T18:00:00Z. All public assets and legal signoff required by 2026-05-31T18:00:00Z (T-24h).

oscar: SI runbook:
```
- git checkout release/cloudbundle-marketplace
- deploy connector v2.0.1
- smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku CB-EDGE
- integration: ./ci/integrate.sh --env staging --partner cloudbundle
- verify: grep -i "handshake ok" /var/log/redwood/connector.log
- upload screenshots to Partnerships/CloudBundle/tests/
```
If firmware mismatch -> fallback: publish listing with "integration pending" badge and disable deploy button.

mina: I27ll flag non-retina images in the content tracker and mark placeholders. Will accept low-res for preview; final must be 2x retina.

alex: Legal needs a 1-sentence partner quote (performance + partnership). @mina can you nudge them?

mina: Pinged CloudBundle marketing with the template. Expect quote by tomorrow 10:30 PT.

deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 11234)
deploy-bot: preview-check succeeded — no broken links detected :white_check_mark:

oscar: Reserved 4 GPUs for load test during the integration slot. I27ll post results here.

alex: Two final asks for green: 1) @ravi confirm CDN path for final images; 2) @oscar post SI run results by 12:00 PT. If no blockers by 12:30 PT we call it "launch-ready" and schedule final dry-run at 13:30 PT.

ravi: CDN path confirmed when assets arrive: https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/cloudbundle/2210/. Will update when hi-res uploaded.

oscar: Integration run complete — smoke + handshake OK, one non-blocking warning in logs. Screenshots uploaded to Partnerships/CloudBundle/tests/run-112.

legal-bot: reminder: legal signoff required. Add "legal-approved" tag to tracker when ready.

alex: Great work. Document test results in Partnerships/Marketplace/CloudBundle/launch-playbook.md and add approvals in the tracker. We flip embargo only after legal, eng, and marketing tags are present. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
